# pbs_remote (Data Source)

Reads a Proxmox Backup Server remote, without its password, which PBS never returns. It does not contact the remote: `pbs_remote_datastores` does. Needs `Remote.Audit` on `/remote/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_remote" "offsite" {
  name = "offsite"
}

# Warn when the remote trusts the offsite server by a fingerprint that is no
# longer the one of its certificate, read there with a second provider
# configuration, aliased offsite.
data "pbs_fingerprint" "offsite" {
  provider = pbs.offsite
}

check "offsite_fingerprint_is_current" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_remote.offsite.fingerprint == null || data.pbs_remote.offsite.fingerprint == data.pbs_fingerprint.offsite.fingerprint
    error_message = "Remote offsite pins ${data.pbs_remote.offsite.fingerprint}, but the offsite PBS serves ${data.pbs_fingerprint.offsite.fingerprint}."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the remote to read, such as `offsite`.

### Read-Only

- `auth_id` (String) User or API token PBS signs in to the remote as.
- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the remote's certificate that PBS accepts, as colon-separated lower-case hex pairs like `pbs_fingerprint`'s, whatever spelling PBS stores; null when PBS accepts only certificates its system's CAs validate.
- `host` (String) DNS name or IP address of the remote.
- `port` (Number) Port of the remote's API; null for the default, 8007.
- `use_node_proxy` (Boolean) Whether PBS connects to the remote through the HTTP proxy of its node configuration.
